argv: `neededTiles` lists the tiles that hold a vertex
ops.body:
- [arch] **Complexes audit** (0147): `neededTiles` lists the tiles that hold a vertex, so a building longer than a z14 tile with no vertex in a middle tile can lose places there (audit 3).
- [arch] A joined outline draws the tiles' clip edges inside a building cut across tiles; it needs a polygon union (audit 9).
- [arch] A release whose `buildings.pmtiles` is missing falls back to no older release the way the places reader does (audit 6).
- [arch] A row for a building that stops qualifying, or is renamed, is never deleted: only a code bump or a purge clears it (audit 7).
- [arch] A fix's accuracy, the antimeridian and label collisions (audit 12).
- [loop] A seeded complex on Memories' card has no journey step (audit 20).
- [loop] After "See more" the first new row should take a screen reader's focus (audit 21).

argv: a shape clipped at a z12 tile edge is judged by the pieces read
ops.body:
- [arch] **Neighborhood boundaries audit** (0152): a shape clipped at a z12 tile edge is judged by the pieces read, so one overlap point can be owned differently by what is kept (audit, first deferral; as towns, TO2).
- [arch] Checklists and finds built under the old nearest-point rule keep their area until the next tile build, so Explore and Chronicle can name different neighborhoods for one place until then (audit, second deferral; `AREA_RULES` does not reach the kept checklist stores).
- [arch] The "Association" filter loses a real neighborhood named so (steward).
- [arch] A macrohood is a big neighborhood where nothing smaller holds a point, with no size cap (steward).
- [arch] A town's page lists a shape with no tile point only from tiles already kept (a listing asks for no more); a share-only neighborhood past 1 km of its point is the town's on Explore (audit 3).
